name: ODRL Asset
abstract: W3C ODRL 2.2 Asset (the resource a rule applies to, identified by IRI, optionally odrl:partOf collections) or AssetCollection (a group of assets, identified by @id, or by odrl:source narrowed with odrl:refinement). In CDIF the asset is normally a distribution or data service. Uses building blocks: odrlConstraint (odrlProperties), objectReference (cdifDataType).
